name: Kingdom of Rurutu (until 1889)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red, the white stripe charged at the centre with a blue panel bearing the name 'RURUTU' in white capitals.
history: The flag of the Kingdom of Rurutu in the Austral Islands, in use from about 1858. A French protectorate in 1889 added a tricolour canton, and the island was annexed in 1900.

features.role: blue panel with the name 'RURUTU' in white
